tess: Hey all 
I'm confused about tomorrow's onboarding slots 
I have one invite at 16:00 UTC and another at 02:00 local (AEST). Which is legit? Also Outlook removed the Zoom passcode from the body so I can't join on my phone. Where are recordings put after the session?

irfan: Welcome @tess! Official time this week is 16:00 UTC (that's 03:00 AEST 

we had a regional shift for APAC). Delete the invite that has "DRAFT" in the title 

For passcodes: we post them in the calendar "Location" field and the pinned thread so mobile/outlook clients still get them.

maria: Re recordings: Google Drive -> New Hires / Session Recordings. We redact vendor/customer PII before moving them from the Private Onboarding folder to the shared folder. If you can't see it, ping me your email.

tess: thanks 
I still don't see last week's security session recording in Drive.

maria: That one is in Private Onboarding while we blur a whiteboard. Adding you to the ACLs now.

calendar-bot: Zoom meeting created: ID 321-654-987, passcode: 9154 (auto-posted)

irfan: I'll paste the join link + passcode into the event description after the session and attach an ICS so phones get the full details. If anyone sees timezone rendering weirdness, DM me a screenshot.

sam: Quick note: we always choose a scribe. @maria can you scribe product tour tomorrow? If not, I'll pull from the rotation.

maria: I can scribe, but note slide 8 has vendor PII that needs redaction before we publish. @irfan can you handle the clip?

irfan: Yep, I'll redact slide 8 and upload the cleaned recording to New Hires/Session Recordings and then update permissions.

tess: one more Q 
I have two invites at the exact same local time but different UTC offsets on different devices. Safe to delete the older one?

irfan: Delete the older/stale invite. Keep the one labeled "Onboarding 




Series 





Product Tour (official)" if present. If unsure, DM me a screenshot and I'll confirm.

calendar-bot: Reminder: Recording will be uploaded to Google Drive and link posted in thread after session.

tess: Great 
Thanks everyone, appreciate the help :thumbsup:
